title: The spectre is not spectral
plain: Show the spectre, a curved tile that cannot tile by translations, has no orthogonal basis of exponentials, as Fuglede's conjecture predicts.
math: Prove there is no $\Lambda\subset\mathbb{R}^2$ such that $\{e^{2\pi i\lambda\cdot x}\}_{\lambda\in\Lambda}$ is an orthogonal basis of $L^2$ of the spectre domain.
